newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH HELICOPTER CRASHES WITH FOUR CREW ON BOARD.
newsitem.headline: POLISH HELICOPTER CRASHES WITH FOUR CREW ON BOARD.

text.p: A Polish naval rescue helicopter with a crew of four crashed into the Baltic early on Wednesday while flying to the aid of a sick fisherman at sea, a naval spokesman said.

Captain Janusz Walczak said in a statement that searchers had found the bodies of two members of the crew of the PZL Anakonda helicopter, which hit the sea in the Bay of Puck at about 1.00 a.m. (2400 GMT).
Four ships, plus other craft and helicopters were still searching the area, but visibility was poor due to heavy mist.
